input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to the Company's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and to a successor in an M&A transaction, and carve them out of the "no other person" limitation in Section 10.3.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (and to a successor in a merger or sale of the business), since our group and outsourced providers need to operate and monitor the Site; our playbook requires affiliate and contractor coverage plus successor transferability. We also carved those parties out of the "no other person shall acquire or have any rights" language in Section 10.3, which as drafted would exclude them; if you prefer, we can accept affiliates being added on written notice to HDI.

ops.oldText: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
ops.newText: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information. The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 may be exercised by the Company, its affiliates (meaning any entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with the Company) and any contractors acting on the Company's behalf, and may be transferred to any successor to the Company's business by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but, other than the Company's affiliates and contractors acting on the Company's behalf (which may exercise the rights granted to the Company under Section 1.4), no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
